breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero by symmetry, but for a simply supported beam under a midspan point load the slope is zero at midspan, not at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly claimed the slope vanishes at the supports (by symmetry). The generated specification correctly ignores this erroneous instruction and instead computes a non-zero slope at the supports using the standard formula θ_support = PL²/(16EI) ≈ 0.0093 rad, which is consistent with the ground truth. The zero-slope condition is implicitly applied at midspan (as it should be for symmetry), not at the supports.
